import os
total=0; n=0
for base,d,files in os.walk('src'):
    for f in files:
        p=os.path.join(base,f); total+=os.path.getsize(p); n+=1
print('files',n,'bytes',total,'entries',len(list(os.walk('src')))-1+sum(len(f) for _,_,f in os.walk('src')))

python3 - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,sys,resource,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/tests')
src=open('/workspace/tmp/tests/maxtest.py').read().replace("\nif __name__ == '__main__':","\nif False:")
g={'__name__':'bt','__file__':'/workspace/tmp/tests/maxtest.py'}
exec(compile(src,'maxtest','exec'),g)
r1=g['build'](3); r2=g['build'](4)
body=json.dumps({"cases":[r1['cases'][0], r2['cases'][0]]},separators=(',',':'))
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'run.py'],input=body.encode(),cwd='/workspace',capture_output=True,timeout=600)
ru=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('2-case elapsed %.2fs rc=%d maxrss %.0f MB out=%d' % (time.time()-t0,p.returncode,ru.ru_maxrss/1024.0,len(p.stdout)))
